part: A, Shift where the check freed pins, the list's lifted and held, each turn ended as a drag

functions.does: The speed key raises and lowers the rear wing: its long axle goes into a hole behind the left rear wheel, into the shaft under the wing, and turning the key swings the wing up on its arms or folds it down flat.

stopsJudged.why: a travel of 0.2 rad or less each way, stopped at +0 rad (1928/2024); -0.14 rad (1929/1944)

byHand.why: page 310 shows two-way curved arrows on the key and a two-way up-down arrow on the wing, so the key must turn both ways far enough to lift the wing visibly; the viewer allows no turn at all one way (stop at +0 rad, 1928/2024). The exact number of key turns is not drawn.

functions.why: a collision stops a control: p1938 59443: a travel of 0.2 rad or less each way, stopped at +0 rad (1928/2024); -0.14 rad (1929/1944) (page 310 shows two-way curved arrows on the key and a two-way up-down arrow on the wing, so the key must turn both ways far enough to lift the wing visibly; the viewer allows no turn at all one way (stop at +0 rad, 1928/2024).
